arabic: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا أَتَاهُ أَمْرٌ يَسُرُّهُ، أَوْ يُسَرُّ بِهِ، خَرَّ سَاجِداً شُكْراً لِلَّهِ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى.
transliteration: Kharra saajidan shukran lillaahi tabaaraka wa ta'aalaa.
translation: When the Prophet (peace be upon him) received a matter that pleased him, or which made him glad, he would fall down in prostration in gratitude to Allah, the Blessed and Exalted.
